# Vendored Typst templates

Copied unmodified from [Typst Universe](https://typst.app/universe) so that compiling
needs no network access. Each directory keeps its original `LICENSE` and `typst.toml`.

| Directory | Package | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `basic-resume/` | basic-resume 0.2.10 | Unlicense | https://github.com/stuxf/basic-typst-resume-template |
| `letter-pro/` | letter-pro 3.0.0 | MIT | https://github.com/Sematre/typst-letter-pro |
